live_curve_metadata.algo_line: paper line: the lane's logged target weights, executed at the close of the lane's execution session and held (carried forward) until the next executed decision, marked at daily closes

execution_clock_definitions.next_session: row dated d = decision from the daily bar of session d, executed at the close of the next session (15:45 ET run) and held from there
execution_clock_definitions.same_session: row dated d = --live-intraday decision from session d's ~15:15 ET bar, executed at the close of session d and held from there

live_curve_metadata.marking: daily close panel (dividend-adjusted closes); cash earns 0; gross of trading costs
live_curve_metadata.start_value: 1.0 at the close of the first executed decision (first curve date)
live_curve_metadata.benchmarks: QQQ/TQQQ buy-and-hold on the same daily close panel, 1.0 on the first curve date
live_curve_metadata.held_weights: per live_equity_curve date: the sleeve weights held over that session (the ones that earn its close-to-close return; zero sleeves omitted, any unallocated remainder shown as weight_cash, which earns 0); absent where they are not in the source (nothing held yet on the first curve date)
